report.explanation: Current evidence does not support the operator's deployment-caused checkout failure hypothesis. Payment checkout trace is OK (71ms), gateway logs show 200/ok, order metrics are healthy (error_rate 0.001, p95 79ms, no timeouts), and the gateway deployment is 1581 minutes old with valid config. No failure is observed, so no bounded root cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Checkout failure telemetry (error traces or 5xx responses) covering the incident window
Payment service error logs or metrics showing failures
Evidence linking gateway 3.1.3 deployment timing to any observed failure
Order/dependency metrics showing timeouts or pool exhaustion during incident
